title: 마력 서고
palette: warm pale limestone, deep desaturated blue trim, bronze accents, tiny cyan crystals
motif: tall clean-cut limestone blocks, thin dark-blue decorative band near top, a few cracks and restrained geometric carvings
mounts: a small cyan crystal wall lamp on a bronze bracket, restrained glow
a shallow arched wall-mounted book niche frame holding three small old books, no surrounding wall
a long hanging dark-blue cloth banner with a simple gold star geometry, torn edge
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Produce one production-ready transparent PNG SPRITE ATLAS for a 2.5D isometric dungeon game. A precisely sliceable sprite sheet, not a scene.
Canvas 2048x1536 with FOUR columns and THREE rows of equal 512x512 invisible cells. Twelve isolated assets exactly, one per cell. No gridlines, labels, captions, text, watermarks, backgrounds or checkerboards. Real alpha transparency with generous gutters. Entire objects inside their cells.
Style: polished hand-painted stylized dungeon game art, crisp readable chunky edges and bevels, soft upper-left lighting, orthographic isometric camera, 2 horizontal pixels for 1 vertical ground pixel. Match a small teal-hooded repair worker and worn stone dungeon. Not pixel art, not photorealistic, not flat icons. Theme: 마력 서고. Palette: warm pale limestone, deep desaturated blue trim, bronze accents, tiny cyan crystals. Wall materials: tall clean-cut limestone blocks, thin dark-blue decorative band near top, a few cracks and restrained geometric carvings.
IMPORTANT STRUCTURE: first SIX assets are standalone VERTICAL WALL PANELS. NO floor diamond, NO platform, NO broad floor slab below them. Actual full-height room wall, much taller than a low fence. Thin slab with narrow visible cap, vertical side edge. Straight vertical left and right ends can butt against another same panel; NO projecting pillars, posts or buttresses at ends. Clearly reveal tall vertical wall FACE, not mostly a top surface.
NW-facing panel: visible broad interior face is a tall parallelogram. Its floor BASE line rises to the RIGHT, slope -1/2 in bitmap coordinates. Make front-face corners approximately cell-local top-left (170,120), top-right (330,40), bottom-right (330,370), bottom-left (170,450). This makes a NARROW TALL wall segment: front face width 160px and upright height 330px. Small 12-20px bevel/cap on outer side. Back/top/sides never cover the main face. Keep 30px padding.
NE-facing panel is the opposite orientation: broad interior wall face BASE line descends to the RIGHT, slope +1/2. Front-face corners approximately top-left (182,40), top-right (342,120), bottom-right (342,450), bottom-left (182,370). Same slab thickness, material scale, wall height and lighting. Render separately, not fake flat front view. NO L-corner in these panels.
Rows/positions:
Row 1:
1. FULL tall wall NW facing, intact plain brick wall.
2. FULL tall wall NE facing, exact paired design at opposite direction.
3. DAMAGED tall wall NW facing, missing upper corner, cracked masonry, main lower wall continuous and same ground base. Only upper 25% missing, not collapsed rubble.
4. DAMAGED tall wall NE facing, paired damage state. Same base, same scale.
Row 2:
1. LOW wall NW facing: exactly same base span and bottom baseline as tall version, but only one-third upright height. No floor underneath.
2. LOW wall NE facing: paired low wall.
3. Isolated wall-mounted attachment NW facing: a small cyan crystal wall lamp on a bronze bracket, restrained glow. No host wall behind it.
4. SAME wall-mounted attachment NE facing, paired orientation. No host wall.
Row 3:
1. Isolated wall-mounted attachment NW facing: a shallow arched wall-mounted book niche frame holding three small old books, no surrounding wall. No host wall.
2. SAME attachment NE facing. No host wall.
3. Isolated wall-mounted attachment NW facing: a long hanging dark-blue cloth banner with a simple gold star geometry, torn edge. No host wall.
4. SAME attachment NE facing. No host wall.
The SIX wall attachments in last six cells are independently placeable overlays: each mounts flush to the corresponding slanted vertical wall plane, follows the same isometric wall-face direction, floats centered in its cell on alpha with NO pedestal/ground/plinth/wall rectangle. NO lettering. Keep all attachments comfortably inside each cell.
Twelve assets only, clean transparent gutters, no floor tiles. Walls look room-height, narrow tall proportions, consistent geometric base span.
